Unnamed: 3: Information on the decision-making level refers to universities (Universitäten) and university colleges of teacher education (Pädagogische Hochschulen). Universities of applied sciences (Fachhochschulen/Hochschulen für Angewandte Wissenschaften) and private higher education institutions have institutional autonomy to decide on the start of the academic year (generally in September or October).

The Higher Education Code specifies that the academic year should start between 1 September and 1 October.
No information is available regarding the independent private sector.

Some private universities start the academic year in September.

The Act on Higher Education and Scientific Activity specifies that the academic year spans between 1 October and 30 September of the following year. Under specific circumstances, some courses may start as early as 1 September.
Some private higher education institutions start the academic year in October.
The official start of the academic year is in August, as defined by the top-level authority.

The decision on the start of the academic year is made by the Länder. For universities of applied sciences (Hochschulen für angewandte Wissenschaften/Fachhochschulen), the academic year typically starts in September.

At ISCED 6, the top-level authority sets the official start of the academic year at 1 September, while institutional higher education institutions determine the start of teaching activities. At ISCED 7, the academic year may start in October or March.
In the private sector the academic year usually starts in October.
No information is available regarding the independent private sector.
For private institutions, the start of the academic year happens at different times of the year.
Some higher education institutions will exceptionally start the academic year in November to adjust to the prolongation of the previous academic year (due to socio-political circumstances).

The top-level authority determines the start of the academic year, as well as the dates of autumn and spring semesters. However, the Institutes decide independently on the periods when teaching activities start.

In some autonomous communities, some non-university tertiary programmes start in October. For those, the autonomous community usually decides on the start of the academic year. However, the decision may be delegated to the provincial directorates or the municipalities.
No information is available regarding the independent private sector.
